summary: The CKGSB-IE report launch is the top priority this week, with urgent tasks around the press release, webpage, and Singapore event, while the knowledge website redesign and the China-focused marketing push for Asia Star and Intelligent China are also in motion.
summaryDetail: The CKGSB-IE report on Chinese companies going global is in final launch mode: the press release needs edits and distribution, the webpage must go live after final approval, and the one-page flyer awaits the QR code. For the September 15-16 Singapore activities, Xuan must draft a Chinese email to Chen Zongchao with the latest speakers and guest list, and Melvin must approve two more guests and add Dean Xiang's speech to the briefing. The knowledge website redesign is progressing with Joseph's HTML file and Joker's changes, but the team needs to sit down and mark specific feedback. The marketing strategy prioritizes Asia Star and Intelligent China for SEO and conversion tracking, with the Intelligent China webpage launching this week, while US programs are on hold. Also, the team must resolve the Outlook password issue by deleting and re-adding accounts on all devices.
